CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  February 5, 2024

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  Bryden, Gardea, Mojarro, Pham

  Staff Present: Maia McCurley, Principal Planner; Vanessa Norwood, Contract Senior
  Planner; Megan Wu, Associate Planner; Jessica Vargas, Assistant Planner;
  Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – January 16, 2024 (7:01 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the January 16, 2024, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the January 16, 2024, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-1-4
  Ayes:  Grijalva, Ho, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Juarez
  Absent: Bryden, Gardea, Mojarro, Pham

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  EXTENSION FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-41
  AND LOT MERGER LOTM-21-04 (7:02 P.M.)
  • 918-924 East Main Street & 5 South Valencia Street

  1
  02/05/2024
   •  Request: This is a request for a two-year extension for the previously
  approved Planned Development Permit PD-20-41 and a one-year
  extension for the previously approved Lot Merger LOTM-21-04 for
  the construction of a new 11,691 square foot two-story commercial
  building consisting of two (2) retail units, one (1) café unit, co-
  working offices, and both covered and uncovered surface parking
  lots, located on a site of approximately 22,800 square feet spanning
  across three (3) parcels (APNs 5346-005-003, -004, and -012) located
  in the EMC (East Main Commercial) and P (Parking) zones.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 24-06 approving a two-
  year extension to February 18, 2025 for the previously approved
  Planned Development Permit PD-20-41 and a one-year extension to
  February 18, 2025 for the previously approved Lot Merger LOTM-
  21-04 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding the
  extensions for Planned Development Permit PD-20-41 and Lot
  Merger LOTM-21-04 to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15332 of
  Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations, which exempts from
  CEQA review projects that are characterized as infill development.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-4
  Ayes:  Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Bryden, Gardea, Mojarro, Pham

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:

  Audio:
  PC Meeting - February 5, 2024 (Audio).m4a

  Video:
  PC Meeting - February 5, 2024 (Video).mp4

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  PLANNING COMMISSION ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES /
  HOUSING LAW UPDATE (7:03 P.M.)
  • This is a report to inform the Planning Commission about their role
  and responsibilities; the Brown Act for open meetings for local
  legislative bodies in California; and recent updates to State housing
  2
  02/05/2024
   laws.
  •  Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the item to the next regularly scheduled Planning
  Commission meeting.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner Juarez.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-4
  Ayes:  Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Bryden, Gardea, Mojarro, Pham

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:

  Audio:
  PC Meeting - February 5, 2024 (Audio).m4a

  Video:
  PC Meeting - February 5, 2024 (Video).mp4

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  PLANNED  DEVELOPMENT  PERMIT  PD-23-66  AND
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-23-32 (7:04 P.M.)
  • 230 West Main Street
  • Request: This is a public hearing for an application for a Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-66 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-
  32 to allow a 5,931 square foot indoor children’s playground and café
  on the first floor of an existing 8,750 square foot, two-story
  commercial building, located at 230 West Main Street, in the CBD
  (Central Business District) zone and Downtown Revitalization
  District Overlay.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 24-03 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-66 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-
  32 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-66 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-
  32 to be exempt from review under the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14
  of the California Code of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA
  review projects that are existing facilities.
  • Contract Senior Planner Vanessa Norwood provided the Staff
  presentation.
  3
  02/05/2024
   •  Sarah Del Rosario, the Applicant and business owner, was available
  to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Tsujii.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-4
  Ayes:  Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Bryden, Gardea, Mojarro, Pham

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-56, CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT CUP-23-23, AND VARIANCE VAR-23-17 (7:13 P.M.)
  • 748 East Valley Boulevard
  • Request: This is a public hearing for an application for a Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-56, Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-23,
  and Variance VAR-23-17 to establish a Mathnasium learning center
  with less than the required number of parking spaces within an
  existing 2,500 square foot commercial lease space located at 748 East
  Valley Boulevard in the VSP (Valley Boulevard Corridor Specific
  Plan) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 24-05 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-56, Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-23,
  and Variance VAR-23-17 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and
  finding Planned Development Permit PD-23-56, Conditional Use
  Permit CUP-23-23, and Variance VAR-23-17 to be exempt from
  review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code
  of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that are
  existing facilities.
  • Assistant Planner Jessica Vargas provided the Staff presentation.
  • Xiaocong Mai, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Tsujii, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-4
  4
  02/05/2024
   Ayes:  Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain  None
  Absent:  Bryden, Gardea, Mojarro, Pham

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:25 P.M. to Monday,
